verdict.rationale: Galileo is an AI observability and evaluation platform that captures every session, trace, and span, so data retention and deletion controls are a fair axis for it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents retention periods, deletion of traces or logs, or data-lifecycle settings. The MCP mention of "creating and managing datasets" is a related dataset-management feature, not retention or deletion control, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
